text:
alex: Quick mini-sweep — changelog cutoff in ~3h. Please do two things: (1) add a one-line blurb to your PRs that touch public APIs or user-facing behavior, (2) add a component tag. Keep it tiny.
sarah: Got it. Do we have a sample we should copy?
alex: Yep — use this shape: `- <component>: short, present-tense summary (impact)` e.g. `- cli: fix race in config load (users upgrading may need to re-run init)`
jamie: For infra/backport owners: please claim any bump or backport PRs you own. If nobody claims within 30m I'll assign to oncall.
chris: Claiming #4528 (version bump + noop migration). I'll drop a blurb in the PR now.
release-bot: heads-up — changelog-cutoff scheduled at <in 3h>. Auto-reminder will post again 30m before cutoff. :alarm_clock:
alex: If your change is internal-only (tests, infra), reply `alex: internal` and I'll skip asking for blurb. Otherwise assume we need something short.
sarah: internal (docs only)
jamie: Question: do we still require the component prefix for tiny perf tweaks?
alex: yes — helps the release notes aggregator. Use `perf:` or the component it touches (e.g., `runtime:`).
chris: PR updated: `- runtime: reduce KV cache memory on start (low risk)` — added component and a one-liner.
jamie: Pushed a tiny blurb to #4532. pinging @alex for sanity check.
alex: looks good — concise and actionable. Thanks.
release-bot: Reminder in 30m: changelog-cutoff — please finish blurb edits or comment with `skip` if irrelevant.
jamie: Also tagging owners for potential backports: @chris @sarah — please confirm within 1h if you want a backport.
chris: I'll take the backport for #4528.
alex: perfect. If anyone's blocked on wording drop it here and I'll help shorten. :thumbsup:
